description: Compare Pfam/PROSITE carrier-repeat copy numbers and annotated TM segments between canonical SLC25 carriers and MTCH proteins
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
ACCS={'AAC1_BOVIN':'P02722','ANT1_HUMAN':'P12235','AAC2_YEAST':'P18239','UCP1_HUMAN':'P25874',
 'UCP2_HUMAN':'P55851','UCP3_HUMAN':'P55916','PIC_HUMAN':'Q00325','CIC_HUMAN':'P53007',
 'CACT_HUMAN':'O43772','ORNT1_HUMAN':'Q9Y619','GDC_HUMAN':'Q9H936','DIC_HUMAN':'Q9UBX3',
 'MTCH2_HUMAN':'Q9Y6C9','MTCH1_HUMAN':'Q9NZJ7','MTCH2_MOUSE':'Q791V5','MTCH2_BOVIN':'Q9N285',
 'MTCH1_MOUSE':'Q791T5','MTCH2_PONAB':'Q5R5M0'}
rows=[]
for nm,acc in ACCS.items():
    j=requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json',timeout=60).json()
    d={'protein':nm,'acc':acc,'class':'MTCH' if 'MTCH' in nm else 'canonical SLC25',
       'Pfam_PF00153_copies':0,'PROSITE_SOLCAR_copies':0,'IPR002067_MCP':False}
    for x in j.get('uniProtKBCrossReferences',[]):
        p={q['key']:q['value'] for q in x.get('properties',[])}
        if x['database']=='Pfam' and x['id']=='PF00153': d['Pfam_PF00153_copies']=int(p.get('MatchStatus',0))
        if x['database']=='PROSITE' and x['id']=='PS50920': d['PROSITE_SOLCAR_copies']=int(p.get('MatchStatus',0))
        if x['database']=='InterPro' and x['id']=='IPR002067': d['IPR002067_MCP']=True
    # count annotated SOLCAR repeat features
    d['n_repeat_features']=sum(1 for f in j.get('features',[]) if f['type']=='Repeat')
    d['n_TM_features']=sum(1 for f in j.get('features',[]) if f['type']=='Transmembrane')
    rows.append(d)
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option('display.width',250)
print(D.to_string(index=False))
D.to_csv('domain_repeat_counts.csv',index=False)
print()
for c,g in D.groupby('class'):
    print('%-18s Pfam copies %.2f  SOLCAR copies %.2f  SOLCAR repeat features %.2f  TM features %.2f'%(
        c,g.Pfam_PF00153_copies.mean(),g.PROSITE_SOLCAR_copies.mean(),g.n_repeat_features.mean(),g.n_TM_features.mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5))
x=np.arange(len(D)); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,D.Pfam_PF00153_copies,w,label='Pfam PF00153 (Mito_carr) copies',color='#2a7f62')
ax.bar(x,D.PROSITE_SOLCAR_copies,w,label='PROSITE PS50920 (SOLCAR) copies',color='#3f7fb5')
ax.bar(x+w,D.n_TM_features,w,label='UniProt annotated TM segments',color='#c08a3e')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(D.protein,rotation=75,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(11.5,color='k',lw=1.2)
ax.text(5,6.4,'canonical SLC25 carriers',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.text(14.5,6.4,'MTCH clade',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('count'); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Carrier-repeat signatures: three detectable SOLCAR repeats in canonical carriers,\none to two in MTCH1/MTCH2',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
